overview: The MNRE Off-grid Solar Power Schemes support decentralized solar energy solutions for areas without reliable grid access. These schemes aim to promote solar electrification in rural and remote regions through financial assistance and implementation support. They focus on standalone solar systems, solar pumps, and other off-grid applications to enhance energy access and sustainability.
objectives: Provide electricity access to unelectrified households and villages
Promote solar-powered irrigation through solar water pumps
Support decentralized renewable energy applications in remote areas
Reduce dependence on diesel generators and fossil fuels in off-grid settings
Enhance livelihoods and productivity through reliable solar power supply
eligibility: Beneficiaries include individuals, farmers, cooperatives, panchayats, and government institutions in off-grid or poorly electrified areas. Systems must comply with MNRE technical standards and be installed by authorized channel partners. Priority is given to SC/ST, women, and border regions.
benefits: Financial subsidies for solar home lights, solar street lights, solar pumps, and mini-grids; reduced electricity costs; reliable power supply; environmental benefits through reduced emissions; and support for agricultural productivity via solar-powered irrigation.
financial_support: Central Financial Assistance (CFA) is provided as a subsidy ranging from 30% to 90% of the benchmark cost, depending on beneficiary category and region (e.g., higher for NE/hilly/island areas). Funds are disbursed through State Nodal Agencies or implementing agencies after installation and inspection.
application_process: 1. Identify eligible off-grid solar system (home light, street light, pump, etc.) 2. Contact State Nodal Agency or authorized channel partner 3. Submit application with required documents 4. System installed by authorized vendor 5. Inspection by concerned authority 6. Subsidy disbursed to beneficiary or vendor
required_documents: Land ownership or consent document (for community/installation site)
Technical specification of the proposed system
Bank account details for subsidy transfer
Photographs of installation site (before and after)
implementing_agency: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
caveats: Subsidy is limited to approved models and manufacturers under ALMM
Systems must be installed by MNRE-authorized channel partners
Beneficiary must not have availed subsidy for the same purpose under any other government scheme
Post-installation monitoring and maintenance responsibility lies with the beneficiary
